key_idea: Positions live on a line, so keep an array of coordinates; a move is a point assignment and a query is an absolute difference.
sketch: Store X[i] in an array. Type 1 overwrites X[C]; type 2 prints |X[A]-X[B]|. O(N+Q). No data structure is needed; coordinates up to 1e9 fit in int but 64-bit was used for safety. A may equal B (answer 0).
